text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If I were the type to throw in the towel over something like this,
I wouldn't have come to this academy in the first place."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: I won't give up until the very end, as long as I'm with you.
Because I won't give up until the very end, together with you.
Extra training when we get back!

text_block_list.text:
“Still, if you truly swear it from the bottom of your heart...
I wouldn't mind making use of you as my trainer
all the way until the very end.”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
All to seize a victory worthy of
this first-rate Umamusume, King Halo!!

text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You're right, we don't even have
time to complain.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph. You actually make a decent proposal once in a while.
